metadata.title: When I accidentally get 3 kills and Valorant’s like ‘Wait, how did you do that?’
metadata.description:
Hold up, did I just carry by pure chance?
Enemies must’ve taken a coffee break mid-fight.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the killfeed’s lit.
Valorant logic is trolling again.

Tap if your best plays feel like happy accidents!
